# Start-up Checklist: ISK-0006 — Host Composition & DI Registration

**Purpose**: Check that the requirements for start-up validation, host-owned refusal, coordination at start, stop, and their failure semantics are complete, clear, and consistent
**Created**: 2026-11-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Validation Timing

- [x] CHK001 - Is "validated once per container" defined, including what triggers it, what runs concurrently, and what a later caller gets? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012, Research R7, Contract §Start-up 1]
- [x] CHK002 - Is registration-time inertness stated for every kind of I/O: documents, stream factories, validation, connections, secrets? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011, Contract §Registration 5]
- [x] CHK003 - Is resolution of a snapshot-dependent service before start defined for both a valid and a rejected configuration? [Coverage, Spec §US2-4, Research R7]
- [x] CHK004 - Is a stop or cancellation during validation defined, including that the next caller starts over? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Start-up 9, Data model §IskenderConfiguration]

## Refusal

- [x] CHK005 - Is the failure for a rejected configuration specified with its code, diagnostics text, diagnostics values, and the order of events? [Completeness, Spec §FR-013, Contract §Start-up 3]
- [x] CHK006 - Is the unreadable-document failure fully specified: its code, diagnostics, values, and which events are and are not written? [Completeness, Spec §Edge Cases, Contract §Start-up 4, Research R15, R16]
  - Settled in `checklist`: the document is read before ISK-0003's validator is called, so no event 3001 to 3003 is written. The failure counts as one error, with `errorCount` and `reportedCount` 1 and event 6002 with an `ErrorCount` of 1, which follows "fails start the same way" in Start-up rule 4 and the maintainer's `plan` decision. Contract Start-up rule 4, research R15 and R16, and task T028 say so.
- [x] CHK007 - Is SC-003's "15 `invalid_request` configuration codes" a fixed, checkable set? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003, Tasks T026]
  - Confirmed against `ErrorCodes.cs`: 15 `config.*` codes have category `invalid_request`.
- [x] CHK008 - Is the no-source case defined, so validation on defaults alone is the expected outcome? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Coordination at Start

- [x] CHK009 - Are the coordination start steps ordered, with what stops the sequence and what runs only after validation succeeds? [Clarity, Spec §TR-7a, Contract §Start-up 6, Research R10]
- [x] CHK010 - Is the missing-coordinator failure distinguished from a rejected configuration? [Clarity, Spec §TR-7a, §US5-4]
- [x] CHK011 - Is the state of the gate and capability report before the start steps complete, and after a failed start, defined as fail-closed? [Completeness, Contract §Start-up 6.4, Research R10]
- [x] CHK012 - Is the timing of the composition start-ups relative to the host's server start stated, along with what a request in that window sees? [Gap, Contract §Known limits]
  - Settled in `checklist`: validation runs in `StartingAsync`, before the server, but the start-ups run in `StartAsync` after the server's own. A request in that window finds the gate fail-closed, and a missing coordinator still fails start. This is now a known limit in the contract.
- [x] CHK013 - Is it stated that a capability refusal does not fail start, with the boundary to ISK-0007 and its assumption? [Dependency, Spec §FR-013a, §AV-2]
- [x] CHK014 - Is when the single-instance guard connects, and when it opens nothing, specified? [Clarity, Contract §Start-up 6.2, Research R10]

## Stop

- [x] CHK015 - Is the stop order defined, together with what the guard does at stop? [Completeness, Contract §Start-up 8, Spec §US1-5]
- [x] CHK016 - Is it stated that migrations and health probes never run at start? [Clarity, Contract §Start-up 10, Spec §Decision Classification]

## Event and Code Consistency

- [x] CHK017 - Are event IDs consistent across spec, contract, research, data model, and tasks, with no reference to an event that does not exist? [Consistency, Spec §TR-13, Contract §Diagnostics, Research R10, R14, R16]
  - Settled in `checklist`: research R10 and R14 named event 6004, which the maintainer's `plan` decision removed. Both now name 6003.
- [x] CHK018 - Is each row of the Registration mistakes table given a failure point, a code, and an event, or the reason it has none? [Completeness, Contract §Registration mistakes]
